attributes.board_name: Indiana Physician Assistant Committee (Indiana Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.alternatives: No separate state hour count: PAs must maintain NCCPA certification to renew to Active status (not required while on Inactive status).
rules.notes: Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years; renewal notices about 90 days before. The 2-hour opioid CE tied to controlled substance registration expired July 1, 2025 (IC 35-48-3-3.5).
